reader_summary.headline: Kimberly Sargent is the Chief Investment Officer of the Packard Foundation where she oversees $10 billion.
reader_summary.overview: Kimberly Sargent is the Chief Investment Officer of the Packard Foundation where she oversees $10 billion. She is a well-respected member of the Yale diaspora, having started her career under David Swensen. Our conversation covers Kim's time at Yale, some lessons learned from David Swensen.

key_points.text: Our conversation covers Kim's time at Yale, some lessons learned from David Swensen.
Kim shares thoughts on a range of asset classes and closes explaining why her role is the best job in the world.
